text: Implemented benchmarks/motion/execution-tiers-v1.json and scripts/run-motion-laptop-gate.mjs with mutation tests. The gate requires exactly 13 passed and zero ignored tests; parses six-DOF, capture, pair, application, and normal-kernel diagnostics; enforces accuracy, allocation, throughput, free-disk, build-growth, log, and receipt budgets; and records the definition hash, dirty revision, launcher Java, actual test JVM, environment, command, checks, and log hash.
